[ASSISTANT_SAID] Comparison between eBay and Poshmark for selling college t-shirts: eBay is best for rare items, fees are 8%-12.5%, responsible for shipping; Poshmark is best for trendy clothing, flat fee of $2.95 for items under $15, 20% for items over $15, provides shipping labels.
